title: Pollen balances now separate tier grants from packs
summary:
Two precise fixes: Pollen balances account for tier resets, and Gemini 3 Flash fast mode uses a zero-token thinking budget.

Tier grants and purchased packs now have separate balances, so daily tier resets do not distort the displayed total. Billable requests use the tier balance first, and Enter’s dashboard reads both balances from the new authenticated balance endpoint.

Requests to disable thinking for Gemini 3 Flash now send a zero-token thinking budget instead of selecting minimal thinking. Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3 Pro keep their existing model-specific settings.
